CT PT:Ao Ratio
犬肺高壓 CT screening flag

Sutherland-Smith et al.：胸腔顯影 CT 上 pulmonary trunk / descending aorta 比值與 TR gradient 中度相關，可提示 moderate/severe PH，但不能區分 mild PH。

1.26mean CT PT:Ao in no PH
1.30mean CT PT:Ao in mild PH
1.57mean CT PT:Ao in moderate PH
1.81mean CT PT:Ao in severe PH
Take-home測量流程Data限制FiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

可以做什麼

在犬胸腔顯影 CT 中，CT PT:Ao 增加可作為 moderate/severe PH 的 screening flag。

不能做什麼

不能可靠偵測 mild PH，也不能取代 echocardiography。

最相關 echo 指標

TR gradient 與 CT PT:Ao 中度正相關：r = 0.61。

臨床建議

若 CT PT:Ao 明顯增加，報告建議 follow-up echo。

CT 測量流程

  1. 選 series：優先使用 arterial-phase postcontrast transverse CT。
  2. 選層面：找 pulmonary trunk 最寬的橫切面，位於左右 pulmonary arteries 分叉前的腹側。
  3. 測 PT：測量 pulmonary trunk 顯影腔內最大直徑，垂直於血管長軸。
  4. 測 Ao：同一張影像測 descending aorta 短軸直徑。
  5. 計算：CT PT:Ao = pulmonary trunk diameter / descending aorta diameter。
  6. 判讀：若比值約 >1.4，依本文資料分布，應提高 moderate/severe PH 懷疑並建議 echo。

  • TR gradient vs CT PT:Ao：r = 0.61，P < 0.0001。
  • Echo 2-D PA:Ao vs CT PT:Ao：r = 0.49，P < 0.0001。
  • PI gradient vs CT PT:Ao：r = 0.49，P < 0.0001。
  • RV AT:ET vs CT PT:Ao：r = -0.12，P = 0.40，無顯著相關。
  • ICC = 0.72，代表 good / fair-to-good reproducibility。
  • Coefficient of variation 約 20-23%。
  • 測量方法簡單，適合臨床 routine thoracic CT 報告中使用。

Interpretation Pitfalls

不要把 CT PT:Ao 當作診斷 cut-off

本文沒有建立 optimal threshold。作者只指出資料分布上約 1.4 可能有助於辨識較可能有 moderate/severe PH 的犬。

Mild PH

mild PH 與 no PH 的 CT PT:Ao 高度重疊。

Measurement choice

此研究用 descending aorta，不是 ascending aorta。

Physiology

CT 在麻醉與正壓通氣下取得，與清醒 echo 不同。

Protocol

顯影時相、注射速率與 slice thickness 不完全標準化。

影像圖例｜Figures

Fig. 1 — CT pulmonary trunk-to-aorta measurement technique

中文：23 kg Siberian Husky 犬的動脈期顯影後胸腔橫切面 CT angiogram，影像位於肺動脈幹水平；該犬心臟超音波估計 tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradient 為 83 mm Hg。CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio 的測量方式為：在肺動脈幹分叉為左右肺動脈前、立即腹側處，測量肺動脈幹最大直徑（實線箭頭，平均 29.6 mm）；並在同一張影像上測量 descending aorta 的短軸直徑（虛線，平均 11.6 mm）。此犬平均 CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio 為 2.55。

English: Arterial-phase postcontrast transverse thoracic angiogram computed tomographic (CT) image at the level of the pulmonary trunk in a 23 kg Siberian Husky dog with an estimated tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradient of 83 mm Hg on an echocardiogram. The CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio measurement technique consists of the maximal pulmonary trunk diameter measured immediately ventral to the bifurcation into the left and right pulmonary arteries (solid line with arrowheads; mean 29.6 mm) and the short axis of the descending part of the aorta diameter (dashed line, mean 11.6 mm). The mean measured CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio in this dog was 2.55.

Fig. 2 — Correlations between CT PT:Ao and echocardiographic indices

中文：四張散佈圖顯示四個心臟超音波參數與 CT pulmonary trunk to aorta diameter ratio（CT PT:Ao）的相關性。A，tricuspid regurgitation（TR）gradient 與 CT PT:Ao ratio 呈統計上顯著的中度相關（r = 0.61，P-value < 0.0001）。B，心臟超音波二維 pulmonary artery to aortic diameter ratio（2-D PA:Ao）與 CT PT:Ao ratio 呈弱至接近中度正相關（r = 0.49，P-value < 0.0001）。C，right ventricular acceleration time-to-ejection time ratio（AT:ET）與 CT PT:Ao ratio 呈負相關，但相關性非常低（r = -0.12）且未達統計顯著（P-value = 0.40）。D，pulmonic insufficiency（PI）pressure gradient 與 CT PT:Ao ratio 呈弱至接近中度正相關（r = 0.49，P-value < 0.0001）。D 圖中的兩個 high-leverage data points 為僅有的兩隻 PI gradient 異常犬，分別為 50 與 63 mm Hg。星號代表統計顯著相關。

English: Graphical scatterplots displaying the four echocardiographic parameters that were correlated with the computed tomography pulmonary trunk to aorta diameter ratio (CT PT:Ao). A, The tricuspid regurgitation (TR) gradient demonstrated a statistically significant moderate correlation with the CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio (r = 0.61, P-value < 0.0001). B, The echocardiographic measurement of two-dimensional pulmonary artery to aortic diameter ratio (2-D PA:Ao) showed a weak, almost moderate positive correlation with the CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio (r = 0.49, P-value < 0.0001). C, The right ventricular acceleration time-to-ejection time ratio (AT:ET) was negatively associated with the CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio, however this relationship exhibited a very low correlation (r = -0.12) that failed to reach statistical significance (P-value = 0.40). D, The pulmonic insufficiency (PI) pressure gradient showed a weak, almost moderate positive correlation with the CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio (r = 0.49, P-value < 0.0001). It should be noted that the two high-leverage data points on scatter plot D represent the only two dogs with an abnormal measured pulmonary insufficiency gradient of 50 and 63 mm Hg, respectively. The * symbols denote a statistically significant correlation.

Fig. 3 — CT PT:Ao distribution by pulmonary hypertension severity

中文：Box and whisker plot 顯示平均 CT pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio（y 軸）依據 tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradient 所分出的四個 pulmonary hypertension 嚴重度類別（x 軸）：無 pulmonary hypertension（n = 13，TR <= 30 mm Hg）、輕度 pulmonary hypertension（n = 12，TR 31-<=50 mm Hg）、中度 pulmonary hypertension（n = 8，TR 51-<=75 mm Hg）與重度 pulmonary hypertension（n = 6，TR > 75 mm Hg）。無 pulmonary hypertension 犬與中度、重度 pulmonary hypertension 犬之間可見統計顯著差異（*）。

English: Box and Whisker Plot of the distribution of mean measured computed tomographic (CT) pulmonary trunk to aorta ratio values (y-axis) grouped by the four categories of pulmonary hypertension severity derived from the following tricuspid regurgitation pressure gradients: no pulmonary hypertension (n = 13), tricuspid regurgitation <= 30 mm Hg; mild pulmonary hypertension (n = 12), tricuspid regurgitation 31-<=50 mm Hg; moderate pulmonary hypertension (n = 8), tricuspid regurgitation 51-<=75 mm Hg; and severe pulmonary hypertension (n = 6), tricuspid regurgitation > 75 mm Hg (x-axis). A statistical difference (*) was noted between the dogs without pulmonary hypertension and those with both moderate and severe pulmonary hypertension.

Clinical Application

Recommended impression

Increased CT pulmonary trunk-to-aorta ratio, which may support moderate-to-severe pulmonary hypertension. Follow-up echocardiography is recommended for confirmation and grading.

Reporting caveat

報告中應加上限制：CT PT:Ao 不可靠偵測 mild PH，也不是 echo 的替代品。它是 trigger，不是 final diagnosis。
